current_episode.title: 113: Why We Chose Benalmádena - The Most Underrated Town on the Costa del Sol [Listener Favourite]

guest.bio_context: Warner is co-host of The Costa Property Podcast and co-founder of W.L. Costa Property, specializing in helping foreign buyers find properties along the Costa del Sol. He has relocated to Spain with his family and now lives in Benalmádena, where he and Sandra work together to match clients with their ideal homes while experiencing the Mediterranean lifestyle firsthand.

context.real_quote: It's that perfect balance that each day brings in terms of, we still have that energy about it where this is our life, we go to work, we have hobbies, we've normal life with the kids, but it's also more relaxed than that life that we were used to experiencing before we made the decision to move to Spain.
key_stats: 325 sunshine days a year in Benalmádena
15 minutes by train from Benalmádena to Málaga City Centre
30 minutes train ride from Málaga airport to Arroyo de la Miel station
Corpus Christi festival in May in Benalmádena Pueblo
Benalmádena Marina awarded one of the best marinas in the world multiple times
Approximately one hour total travel time from airport landing to settled on terrace at home

pending_qa.q: What transportation option makes Benalmádena unique among coastal towns on the Costa del Sol?
